# Artifacts Router

`docs/assets/artifacts/` is a managed/template asset and an **optional, zero-contract** home for free-form,
pre-design inputs — raw ideas, meeting and transcript notes, sketches, specs,
diagrams, schema drafts, requirements, and supplemental reference material that
hydrate downstream design, planning, and PRD work.

- Nothing here is authoritative or contract-bound. make-docs imposes no
  required structure, naming, or headings on artifacts.
- The directory is optional; nothing downstream depends on it. When present,
  agents may read it to inform designs and plans, but must not treat it as a
  contract.
- Do not generate plans, PRDs, work backlogs, designs, guides, or breadcrumb
  records here. Those have their own output directories.
<!-- make-docs:end -->
